name: Contour: armor shaped to the body
description: Shape the armor to the body in the incoming image, as if made to measure and unless this prompt says otherwise: the breastplate or bodice is moulded over the bust, lifting and supporting it into a full, firm, rounded form with a crisp, clearly defined cleavage line at the centre; the waist is cinched and defined and the hips follow their natural curve.
notes: Optional line (components.body_contour) for armor that should read as form-fitting and keep the bust lifted and visible.
